name: Hezrul's Head
summary: At Lushwater Oasis, Hezrul Bloodmark commands the Kolkar centaur of the Barrens. His head goes to Regthar Deathgate, west of the Crossroads, as proof their chieftain has fallen.

sections.title: Decapitating the Kolkar
sections.body:
Hezrul Bloodmark leads his Kolkar clan from Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads. The centaur hold the Barrens' oases and threaten Horde supply routes and young settlements.

Regthar Deathgate is an orc veteran charged with securing the land west of the Crossroads. He sees fierce rage in the Kolkar, but little discipline. So he demands Hezrul's severed head to break the clan's command and scatter its surviving fighters, weakening their attacks on the Horde.

faq.q: Who does this head belong to?
faq.answer: Hezrul Bloodmark leads the Kolkar centaur clan in the central Barrens.
Hezrul leads his band around Lushwater Oasis, south of the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Regthar Deathgate, an orc at a military outpost on the road west of the Crossroads, wants Hezrul's Head as proof that Hezrul has been defeated.

faq.q: Why does the Horde require his head instead of just driving him away?
faq.answer: The Horde needs certainty that Hezrul is dead. The centaur are volatile and prone to infighting. Removing their chieftain breaks their command and weakens their threat to the Crossroads.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, claiming the Kolkar chieftain's head secures vital water rights at Lushwater Oasis and protects Horde travelers crossing the Barrens.
As an orc, you may see the Kolkar as undisciplined ruffians whose fury gives way to orcish battle discipline. Regthar sees the trophy as proof of martial honor.
